labels.demonstration_ledger: DEMONSTRATION LEDGER: these events are not a user's holdings (P8); they exist to exercise the engine.
labels.label: SYNTHETIC: every result below was computed from a market-data version that holds synthetic files; none is a real market fact (market-data Ruling 4.8).
labels.pd_0035_caveat: PD-0035 section 3: Mainland China and Hong Kong price behaviour is shown on SYNTHETIC data only. No admissible real CN or HK price source exists (PD-0031, PD-0032); the real slice is US prices (Alpha Vantage, the last 100 sessions) and ECB FX only. A synthetic result is never a real market fact (market-data Ruling 4.8).
